description.value: The OSM node records a bar called The Wine Bar on Marinaside Crescent in Vancouver's Yaletown waterfront neighbourhood. The associated website resolves to Provence Marinaside, an award-winning French seafood restaurant and bar, suggesting either a business name change or an incorrectly matched URL. The waterfront location along the Seawall would make it a convenient stop for cycling tourists passing through Yaletown.
